Apple (AAPL) vs Intel (INTC): on the same formula, their operating margins are 37.2 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AAPL: $478.8B · INTC: $52.9B
• Revenue growth — AAPL: +15.1% · INTC: −0.5%
• Operating margin — AAPL: 33.0% · INTC: −4.2%
• Net margin — AAPL: 27.6% · INTC: −0.5%
• Free cash flow margin — AAPL: 28.4% · INTC: −9.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AAPL: 5.0% · INTC: −9.6%

Different fiscal years: AAPL Sep 26, 2026 · INTC Dec 27, 2025. The periods are not identical.
